outcome: completely epithelialized, avascular and stable corneal surface
cohort: Two patients: one with unilateral Limbal Stem Cell Deficiency (LSCD) following acid injury and another with bilateral LSCD due to severe dry eye.
finding: A completely epithelialised, avascular and stable corneal surface was achieved by 4 weeks in both patients treated with Simple Limbal Epithelial Transplantation (SLET).
